notInstalled: The helper is not installed. Run install.sh from the omarchy-amnezia repository.
hint: Right-click the bar icon to connect or disconnect. Obfuscation adds junk packets before the handshake; any WireGuard server accepts them.
diagnose: Diagnose in a sandbox (does not touch your connection)
diagnosing: Testing in a sandbox namespace… (about 10 s, your connection is untouched)
adviceNoHandshake: The server never answered. Your network is probably blocking it: turn on obfuscation and diagnose again.
adviceNoTraffic: Handshake works but no traffic passes. The server may be overloaded; try another config.
adviceOk: This config works. Click it to connect.
notePingBlocked: Ping is blocked by this server (common, e.g. Proton free), so the Wi-Fi panel's packet-loss figure will read 100% even though web traffic works.
